briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 multi-agent release intensifies US-China AGI competition as compute constraints tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has entered a high-velocity phase with frontier labs releasing agentic systems weekly. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over uncontrolled multi-agent interactions. DialectForge's protocol-level defenses are gaining traction in enterprise pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus featuring extended context windows. Google DeepMind released Gemini 3 Ultra while xAI shipped Grok-3 on expanded Memphis supercluster. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines mandate runtime dialect verification for federal AI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped; Microsoft and CoreWeave announced joint 200MW Texas AI campus. TSMC reports 2nm AI chip yields improving faster than projected.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems cross the autonomy threshold before regulatory frameworks can enforce protocol-level security standards?
